description: ECOWAS region (West Africa) - Power Plants is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Daniel Paco (ECREEE). Dataset includes PV plants, Wind plants, Hydro Power plants, Biomass plants, and conventional energy power plants (coal, diesel, gas and heavy fuel) in ECOWAS region and categorized accordingly as operational or planned within a wide range operating capacity in MW. The data is updated on May 2017. Coverage: 15 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Power system and utilities, Renewable energy, Thermal power. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
